component.title: ObjectField
component.purpose: A nested object group that preserves hierarchy, focus order, and recovery context.

states.description: Related values are grouped under one calm, optionally collapsible section.
A group-level error provides recovery context while preserving child inputs.

claims.statement: The object heading, description, issue count, and child values form one semantic section.
Validation preserves the nested inputs and leaves the recovery path visible.
Nested fields reflow within the section at narrow widths without document overflow.
